note: Which manifest models ragdoll on death, as data. A model is a humanoid (a rig family bone map and a measured body row) or a chain creature (`chain`: the package body of that name, partAlias maps the shared hit-part ids onto its own parts). live=false keeps the baked death. The simultaneous-ragdoll cap is data/physicsBudget.json; over it the death is baked too. Humanoid bodies are measured at the bind pose (package tools/glb-measure.mjs) at x1: the actor root carries the manifest scale.
